info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Petadoption Pets Details-v4-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Details API allows users to access comprehensive information about pets available for adoption. This endpoint serves detailed attributes of each pet, supporting organizations and individuals looking to adopt. Typical consumers include animal shelters, adoption agencies, and potential pet adopters seeking to make informed decisions. By retrieving this data, users can engage with the adoption process more effectively and contribute to finding loving homes for pets in need.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific pet.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the detailed information of a specific pet by its unique identifier. It provides a comprehensive set of attributes related to the pet, enabling users to gain insight into various aspects of the pet's profile.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving details about pets. Clients should provide specific parameters to filter and request detailed information on pets they are interested in. The provided JSON object must conform to the specified schema.
